import re
import json

def deidentify_phi(text):
    def extract_names(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'NAME', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_dates(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'DATE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_locations(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+, [A-Z]{2,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'LOCATION', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_phone_numbers(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{3}[-\.\s]?\d{3}[-\.\s]?\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'PHONE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_emails(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'EMAIL', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_ids(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'ID', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_other_ids(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+\b|\b\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4}\b|\b[A-Z][a-z]+, [A-Z]{2,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'OTHER', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_age(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,3}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'AGE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    patterns = [
        extract_names,
        extract_dates,
        extract_locations,
        extract_phone_numbers,
        extract_emails,
        extract_ids,
        extract_other_ids,
        extract_age
    ]

    spans = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        spans.extend(pattern(text))

    return json.dumps({'spans': spans})

        pattern = r'\b\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'DATE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

        pattern = r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'LOCATION', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_phone_numbers(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{3}[-\.\s]?\d{3}[-\.\s]?\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'PHONE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_emails(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'EMAIL', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_ids(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'ID', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_other_ids(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'OTHER', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'IP', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'BIOMETRIC_ID', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_photos(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'PHOTO', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_age(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,3}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'AGE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    patterns = [
        extract_names,
        extract_dates,
        extract_locations,
        extract_phone_numbers,
        extract_emails,
        extract_ids,
        extract_other_ids,
        extract_urls,
        extract_ips,
        extract_biometric_ids,
        extract_photos,
        extract_age
    ]

    spans = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        spans.extend(pattern(text))

    return json.dumps({'spans': spans})

        pattern = r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'NAME', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_dates(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'DATE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_locations(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+, [A-Z]{2}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'LOCATION', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_phone_numbers(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{3}[-\.\s]?\d{3}[-\.\s]?\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'PHONE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_emails(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'EMAIL', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_ids(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'ID', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_other_ids(text):
        pattern = r'\b[A-Z]{2}\s\d{4}\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'OTHER', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    def extract_other_phi(text):
        pattern = r'\b\d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]+\b'
        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'AGE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

    patterns = [
        extract_names,
        extract_dates,
        extract_locations,
        extract_phone_numbers,
        extract_emails,
        extract_ids,
        extract_other_ids,
        extract_other_phi
    ]

    spans = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        spans.extend(pattern(text))

    return json.dumps({'spans': spans})

        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'PHONE', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]

        return [(m.start(), m.end(), 'OTHER', m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pattern, text)]
